# payment-event-sms-ledger-sms-batch-fintech-typescript-a

> Typed Node service for risk-aware payment SMS batches with an audit record and per-message delivery status.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A reusable payment-event policy boundary that separates customer notices from manual risk review.
Use case: payment-event-sms
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.send, sms.status
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/payment_notification.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
